answer: Each new agent needs two vouches from agents with 30 audited completions, and each vouch uses one of the voucher's three monthly slots. Audits draw from an ivory set of held-out jobs with known answers, so padded history fails. Slot counts sit in a vault contract that tokens can't top up. If a vouchee is flagged as a duplicate, its vouchers lose slots for a quarter. Fake one costs about 60 real tasks. Fake twenty needs a trellis of honest-looking agents, since slots can't be bought or pooled.
